### 1. Format Data

Fix some labelling issues:

```{r}
# Fix some labelling issues
master_data$site[master_data$site == "NTNU"] <- "Trondheim"
master_data$site[master_data$site == "Melbourne"] <- "Christchurch"
master_data$site[master_data$dataset == "juelich-petcoffee-bids"] <- "Cologne"
master_data$site[master_data$dataset == "juelich-somnosafe-bids"] <- "Cologne"
master_data$group[master_data$dataset == "singapore-alfie-bids"] <- "3"

# Fix a mistake in the one-hot encoding of chronotype
master_data <- master_data %>%
  mutate(
    chrono_morning = ifelse(is.na(chronotype), NA, chrono_morning),
    chrono_evening = ifelse(is.na(chronotype), NA, chrono_evening)
  )
```


R prefers data in a narrow ("melted") format. This means we create two rows for each subject, one where `SD = 0` (i.e. the baseline condition) and one where `SD = 1` (i.e. the sleep deprived condition). This formatting will facilitate some later analyses in R.

```{r}
# Fix some labelling issues
master_data$site[master_data$site == "NTNU"] <- "Trondheim"
master_data$site[master_data$site == "Melbourne"] <- "Christchurch"
master_data$site[master_data$dataset == "juelich-petcoffee-bids"] <- "Cologne"
master_data$site[master_data$dataset == "juelich-somnosafe-bids"] <- "Cologne"
master_data$group[master_data$dataset == "singapore-alfie-bids"] <- "3"

# Fix a mistake in the one-hot encoding of chronotype
master_data <- master_data %>%
  mutate(
    chrono_morning = ifelse(is.na(chronotype), NA, chrono_morning),
    chrono_evening = ifelse(is.na(chronotype), NA, chrono_evening)
  )

# Duplicate rows and define structural vs actual SD flags
melted_data <- master_data[rep(1:nrow(master_data), each = 2), ] %>%
  mutate(
    sd_original = rep(c(FALSE, TRUE), times = nrow(master_data)), # session pairing (baseline vs "sd" row)
    ses = factor(ifelse(sd_original, "2", "1")),                      # session label
    sd = ifelse(group %in% c("1", "2"), FALSE, sd_original)          # deprivation flag (controls FALSE)
  )

# Helper to coerce possible different time representations into hms 
coerce_to_hms <- function(vec) {
  if (inherits(vec, "hms")) return(vec)
  if (inherits(vec, "POSIXt")) return(hms::as_hms(as.POSIXct(vec)))
  if (is.character(vec)) return(hms::as_hms(vec))
  if (is.numeric(vec)) return(hms::as_hms(vec)) 
  vec
}

# Coerce time columns (and any other time columns if needed)
if ("time_bl" %in% names(melted_data) && "time_sd" %in% names(melted_data)) {
  melted_data <- melted_data %>%
    mutate(
      time_bl = coerce_to_hms(time_bl),
      time_sd = coerce_to_hms(time_sd)
    )
}

# Combine function
combine_baseline_sd <- function(data, base_col, sd_col, new_col, handle_na_pair = FALSE) {
  # if needed, enforce NA-pairing semantics before combining
  if (handle_na_pair) {
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(
        !!sym(base_col) := ifelse(is.na(.data[[base_col]]) != is.na(.data[[sd_col]]),
                                  NA, .data[[base_col]]),
        !!sym(sd_col) := ifelse(is.na(.data[[base_col]]), NA, .data[[sd_col]])
      )
  }
  
  # Create the new column by copying the baseline and replacing rows where sd_original == TRUE
  data %>%
    mutate(
      !!sym(new_col) := {
        base_vec <- .data[[base_col]]
        sd_vec   <- .data[[sd_col]]
        # If sd_original is TRUE for that row, take sd_vec value; otherwise keep base_vec.
        idx <- which(.data$sd_original)
        # guard against length mismatch / all NA
        if (length(idx) > 0) {
          base_vec[idx] <- sd_vec[idx]
        }
        base_vec
      }
    )
}

# Apply the combine function to your variables
melted_data <- melted_data %>%
  combine_baseline_sd("time_bl", "time_sd", "time") %>%
  combine_baseline_sd("kss_score_baseline", "kss_score_sd", "kss") %>%
  combine_baseline_sd("pvt_meanrs_bl", "pvt_meanrs_followup", "pvt_meanrs") %>%
  combine_baseline_sd("pvsvf_baseline", "pvsvf_sd", "pvsvf") %>%
  combine_baseline_sd("cpvf_baseline", "cpvf_sd", "cpvf") %>%
  combine_baseline_sd("mfwi_baseline", "mfwi_sd", "mfwi", handle_na_pair = TRUE) %>%
  combine_baseline_sd("alps_baseline", "alps_sd", "alps", handle_na_pair = TRUE)

# Select columns
melted_data <- melted_data %>%
  dplyr::select(participant_id, site, dataset, group, total_deprivation, time,
                age, sex_male, chrono_morning, chrono_evening, psqi_score, bmi, handedness,
                sd, ses, kss, pvt_meanrs, pvsvf, cpvf, mfwi, alps) |>
  arrange(site)

melted_data
```

Refactorise chronotype and protocol:

```{r}
melted_data <- melted_data %>%
  mutate(
    chronotype = case_when(
      chrono_morning ~ "morning",
      chrono_evening ~ "evening",
      is.na(chrono_morning) | is.na(chrono_evening) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ "intermediate"
    ),
    chronotype = factor(chronotype),
    condition = case_when(
      sd == FALSE ~ "NS", # Baseline
      sd == TRUE & total_deprivation == FALSE ~ "SR", # Sleep Restricted
      sd == TRUE & total_deprivation == TRUE ~ "SD", # Sleep Deprived
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # just in case of unexpected combos
    ),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("NS", "SR", "SD"))
  )
```

### 3. Dataframe

Create a dataframe for the linear mixed model:

```{r}
lme_df <- long_data %>%
  group_by(index) %>% # Temporarily group by index
  mutate(value_z = scale(value), # Z-score the values
         value_z = ifelse(index == "alps", -value_z, value_z),
         value_prop = (value - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
           (max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
         value_prop = case_when(
           value_prop == 0 ~ 0.001,
           value_prop == 1 ~ 0.999,
           TRUE ~ value_prop) # Make sure we don't have exactly 0 or 1
         ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value_z)) |> # Filter out missing data
  filter(abs(value_z) <= 3) |>  # Remove outliers
  mutate(time_sec = as.numeric(as_hms(time))) |> # converts HH:MM:SS → seconds
  mutate(time_sec_z = scale(time_sec)) 
```

Also create a df that separates SR1/aSR and SR3-5/cSR:

```{r}
sr_df <- lme_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = as.character(condition),
    
    condition_long = dplyr::case_when(
      condition == "SR" & dataset %in% c(
        "ntnu-bids"
      ) ~ "SR3",
      
      condition == "SR" & dataset %in% c(
        "juelich-petcoffee-bids",
        "juelich-sleepless-bids"
      ) ~ "SR5",
      
      condition == "SR" ~ "SR1",
      
      TRUE ~ condition
    ),
    
    condition = dplyr::case_when(
      condition_long == "SR1"             ~ "aSR",
      condition_long %in% c("SR3", "SR5") ~ "cSR",
      TRUE                                ~ condition_long
    ),
    
    condition      = factor(condition,      levels = c("NS", "aSR", "cSR", "SD")),
    condition_long = factor(condition_long, levels = c("NS", "SR1", "SR3", "SR5", "SD"))
  )

sr_df
```

### 4. KSS and PVT

Run KSS model (cumulative link mixed model):

```{r}
kss_clmm <- clmm(
  as.factor(kss) ~ condition + (1 | participant_id),
  data = sr_df
)
```

Inspect:

```{r}
summary(kss_clmm)
```
KSS estimated marginal means:

```{r}
kss_emm <- emmeans(kss_clmm, ~ condition, mode = "mean.class")
kss_contrasts <- pairs(kss_emm, adjust = "fdr") %>%
  as.data.frame()
kss_contrasts
```
Create a function for formatting contrasts for the plot:

```{r}
format_contrasts <- function(df, cond_levels = c("NS", "aSR", "cSR", "SD")) {
  out <- as.data.frame(df) |>
    tidyr::separate(contrast, into = c("cond1", "cond2"), sep = " - ") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      cond1 = factor(trimws(cond1), levels = cond_levels),
      cond2 = factor(trimws(cond2), levels = cond_levels)
    )
  
  if (anyNA(out$cond1) || anyNA(out$cond2)) {
    warning("Some contrast labels don't match cond_levels. Check that the model uses the recoded conditions.")
  }
  
  out
}

kss_contrasts_df <- format_contrasts(kss_contrasts)
```

Create a function for mixed violin plots:

```{r}
plot_mixed_violin <- function(sr_df, value_col, emm_df, contrasts_df, ylab,
                              cond_levels = c("NS", "aSR", "cSR", "SD")) {
  
  get_sig_label <- function(p) {
    dplyr::case_when(
      p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE      ~ "ns"
    )
  }
  
  # Raw data: drop NAs, set order, numeric copy of the outcome
  plot_df <- sr_df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(condition), !is.na(.data[[value_col]])) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      condition = factor(condition, levels = cond_levels),
      y_num     = as.numeric(as.character(.data[[value_col]]))
    )
  
  if (!is.numeric(plot_df$y_num) || all(is.na(plot_df$y_num))) {
    stop("Could not convert `", value_col, "` to numeric.")
  }
  
  levels_present <- cond_levels[cond_levels %in% unique(as.character(plot_df$condition))]
  plot_df$condition <- factor(plot_df$condition, levels = levels_present)
  
  # EMMs
  emm_plot <- as.data.frame(emm_df) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(condition)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = levels_present))
  
  # Bracket layout
  y_max  <- max(plot_df$y_num, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng  <- diff(range(plot_df$y_num, na.rm = TRUE))
  y_base <- y_max + 0.10 * y_rng
  y_step <- 0.10 * y_rng
  y_tick <- 0.02 * y_rng
  
  brackets_df <- as.data.frame(contrasts_df) |>
    dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pos1       = match(as.character(cond1), levels_present),
      pos2       = match(as.character(cond2), levels_present),
      left       = pmin(pos1, pos2),
      right      = pmax(pos1, pos2),
      span       = right - left,
      annotation = get_sig_label(p.value)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pos1), !is.na(pos2)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      tier       = as.integer(factor(span)),
      y.position = y_base + (tier - 1) * y_step
    )
  
  y_top <- if (nrow(brackets_df) > 0) max(brackets_df$y.position) + 0.6 * y_step else y_max
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = condition, y = y_num, fill = condition)) +
    geom_violin(color = "black", alpha = 1) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.05, fill = "black", color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_line(data = emm_plot,
              aes(x = condition, y = mean.class, group = 1),
              color = "grey40", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = emm_plot,
               aes(x = condition, y = mean.class),
               size = 4, shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 1.2,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df,
                 aes(x = left, xend = right, y = y.position, yend = y.position),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df,
                 aes(x = left, xend = left, y = y.position, yend = y.position - y_tick),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df,
                 aes(x = right, xend = right, y = y.position, yend = y.position - y_tick),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = brackets_df,
              aes(x = (left + right) / 2, y = y.position + 0.3 * y_step, label = annotation),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = protocolors) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_top)) +
    labs(x = "Sleep Condition", y = ylab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

```

Create a function for PVT plotting using means and contrasts:

```{r}
plot_pvt <- function(df, contrasts_df, cond_levels = c("NS", "aSR", "cSR", "SD")) {
  
  get_sig_label <- function(p) {
    dplyr::case_when(
      p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE      ~ "ns"
    )
  }
  
  # clean raw data  
  df_plot <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pvt_meanrs), !is.na(condition)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      condition  = factor(condition, levels = cond_levels),
      pvt_meanrs = as.numeric(as.character(pvt_meanrs))
    )
  
  levels_present <- cond_levels[cond_levels %in% unique(as.character(df_plot$condition))]
  df_plot$condition <- factor(df_plot$condition, levels = levels_present)
  
  # means  
  mean_df <- df_plot |>
    dplyr::group_by(condition) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_pvt = mean(pvt_meanrs, na.rm = TRUE),
      se       = sd(pvt_meanrs, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
      .groups  = "drop"
    )
  
  # contrasts: split the label only if it hasn't been done yet  
  contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(contrasts_df)
  if (!all(c("cond1", "cond2") %in% names(contrasts_df))) {
    contrasts_df <- contrasts_df |>
      tidyr::separate(.data$contrast, into = c("cond1", "cond2"), sep = " - ")
  }
  
  # bracket layout  
  y_min  <- min(df_plot$pvt_meanrs, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max  <- max(df_plot$pvt_meanrs, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng  <- y_max - y_min
  y_base <- y_max + 0.10 * y_rng
  y_step <- 0.10 * y_rng
  y_tick <- 0.02 * y_rng
  
  brackets_df <- contrasts_df |>
    dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pos1       = match(trimws(as.character(cond1)), levels_present),
      pos2       = match(trimws(as.character(cond2)), levels_present),
      left       = pmin(pos1, pos2),
      right      = pmax(pos1, pos2),
      span       = right - left,
      annotation = get_sig_label(p.value)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pos1), !is.na(pos2)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      tier       = as.integer(factor(span)),
      y.position = y_base + (tier - 1) * y_step
    )
  
  y_top    <- if (nrow(brackets_df) > 0) max(brackets_df$y.position) + 0.6 * y_step else y_max
  y_bottom <- y_min - 0.05 * y_rng
  
  # plot  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = condition, y = pvt_meanrs, fill = condition)) +
    geom_violin(color = "black", alpha = 1) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.05, fill = "black", color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_line(data = mean_df,
              aes(x = condition, y = mean_pvt, group = 1),
              color = "grey40", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = mean_df,
               aes(x = condition, y = mean_pvt),
               size = 4, shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 1.2,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df,
                 aes(x = left, xend = right, y = y.position, yend = y.position),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df,
                 aes(x = left, xend = left, y = y.position, yend = y.position - y_tick),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df,
                 aes(x = right, xend = right, y = y.position, yend = y.position - y_tick),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = brackets_df,
              aes(x = (left + right) / 2, y = y.position + 0.3 * y_step, label = annotation),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = protocolors) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_bottom, y_top)) +
    labs(x = "Sleep Condition", y = "PVT Mean RS") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

Bland-Altman plot

```{r}
stockholm <- stockholm %>%
  mutate(
    average = (pvsvf_frangi + pvsvf_shiva) / 2,
    difference = pvsvf_frangi - pvsvf_shiva
  )

# Compute Bland–Altman stats
mean_diff <- mean(stockholm$difference, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff <- sd(stockholm$difference, na.rm = TRUE)
loa_upper <- mean_diff + 1.96 * sd_diff
loa_lower <- mean_diff - 1.96 * sd_diff

# Plot

  geom_hline(yintercept = loa_lower, color = "red", linetype = "dotted") +
```

### 6. Composite model

Z-Normalize Indices:

```{r}
lme_df <- long_data %>%
  group_by(index) %>% # Temporarily group by index
  mutate(value_z = scale(value), # Z-score the values
         value_z = ifelse(index == "alps", -value_z, value_z),
         value_prop = (value - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
           (max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
         value_prop = case_when(
           value_prop == 0 ~ 0.001,
           value_prop == 1 ~ 0.999,
           TRUE ~ value_prop) # Make sure we don't have exactly 0 or 1
         ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value_z)) |> # Filter out missing data
  filter(abs(value_z) <= 3) |>  # Remove outliers
  mutate(time_sec = as.numeric(as_hms(time))) |> # converts HH:MM:SS to seconds
  mutate(time_sec_z = scale(time_sec)) 
```

Create a function for fitting the LME model:

```{r}
fit_lme <- function(lme_df) {
  # Fit the linear mixed-effects model
  model <- nlme::lme(
    value_z ~ condition * index + age + sex_male + time_sec_z,
    random = ~ 1 | participant_id,
    data = lme_df
  )
  
  # Model summary
  print(summary(model))
  
  # Create a tidy report with FDR-adjusted p-values
  report <- broom.mixed::tidy(model) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
      p.sig = dplyr::case_when(
        p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE          ~ "ns"
      )
    )
  
  # Display compact results
  print(report %>% dplyr::select(term, estimate, p.adj, p.sig))
  
  # Assumption checks 
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  # 4 plots in one window
  
  # Shapiro-Wilkes
  print(shapiro.test(resid(model)))
  
  # Residuals vs Fitted
  plot(fitted(model), resid(model),
       xlab = "Fitted values", ylab = "Residuals",
       main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
  abline(h = 0, col = "red")
  
  # Q-Q plot of residuals
  qqnorm(resid(model), main = "Q-Q plot of residuals")
  qqline(resid(model))
  
  # Q-Q plot of random effects
  ranef_vals <- nlme::ranef(model)[[1]]
  qqnorm(ranef_vals, main = "Q-Q plot of random effects (intercepts)")
  qqline(ranef_vals)
  
  # ACF plot of residuals
  acf(resid(model), main = "ACF of residuals")
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))  # reset
  
  # Estimated Marginal Means
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(model, ~ condition | index)
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)
  
  contrasts <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", adjust = "fdr") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  print(contrasts)
  
  # Effects plot
  tryCatch({
    eff_obj <- effects::allEffects(model)
    plot(eff_obj)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("⚠️ Could not plot allEffects(): ", e$message)
  })
  
  return(list(model = model, report = report, emm = emm, contrasts = contrasts))
}
```

Fit the model:

```{r}
results <- fit_lme(lme_df)
results$report
```

It appears the residuals are non-normal. 
Create a function for fitting a robust LME:

```{r}
fit_rlme <- function(lme_df) {
  # Fit robust linear mixed-effects model
  model_robust <- robustlmm::rlmer(
    value_z ~ condition * index + age + sex_male + time_sec_z +
      (1 | participant_id) + (1 | site),
    data = lme_df
  )
  
  # Model summary
  print(summary(model_robust))
  
  # Tidy output
  report <- broom.mixed::tidy(model_robust)
  print(report)
  
  # Assumption checks  
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  # 4-panel layout
  
  # Residuals vs Fitted
  plot(fitted(model_robust), resid(model_robust),
       xlab = "Fitted values", ylab = "Residuals",
       main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
  abline(h = 0, col = "red")
  
  # Q-Q plot of residuals
  qqnorm(resid(model_robust), main = "Q-Q plot of residuals")
  qqline(resid(model_robust))
  
  # Q-Q plot of random effects
  ranef_df <- ranef(model_robust)[[1]]
  ranef_vals <- ranef_df[, 1]
  qqnorm(ranef_vals, main = "Q-Q plot of random effects (intercepts)")
  qqline(ranef_vals)
  
  # ACF of residuals
  acf(resid(model_robust), main = "ACF of residuals")
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))  # reset layout
  
  # Shapiro-Wilk test
  cat("\nShapiro-Wilk normality test on residuals:\n")
  print(shapiro.test(resid(model_robust)))
  
  # Effects plot
  tryCatch({
    eff_obj <- effects::allEffects(model_robust)
    plot(eff_obj)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("⚠️ Could not plot allEffects(): ", e$message)
  })
  
  # Estimated marginal means and contrasts  
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(model_robust, ~ condition | index)
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)
  
  contrasts <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", adjust = "fdr") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  print(contrasts)
  
  # Return everything
  return(list(
    model = model_robust,
    report = report,
    emm = emm_df,
    contrasts = contrasts
  ))
}
```

Create a function for making violin plots from RLME outcomes:

```{r}
plot_rlme2 <- function(lme_df, emm_df, contrasts, comparison = c("all", "NS_SR", "NS_SD")) {
  comparison <- match.arg(comparison)
  
  # Determine which conditions to include  
  conditions_to_keep <- switch(
    comparison,
    "all"   = c("NS", "SR", "SD"),
    "NS_SR" = c("NS", "SR"),
    "NS_SD" = c("NS", "SD")
  )
  
  # Filter data frames  
  lme_plot <- lme_df %>% dplyr::filter(condition %in% conditions_to_keep) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value_plot = ifelse(index == "alps", -value_z, value_z))
  
  emm_plot <- emm_df %>% dplyr::filter(condition %in% conditions_to_keep) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      emmean_plot = ifelse(index == "alps", -emmean, emmean),
      asymp.LCL_plot = ifelse(index == "alps", -asymp.LCL, asymp.LCL),
      asymp.UCL_plot = ifelse(index == "alps", -asymp.UCL, asymp.UCL)
    )
  
  # Prepare significance labels  
  get_sig_label <- function(p) {
    if (p < 0.001) return("***")
    else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
    else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
    else return("ns")
  }
  
  # Filter contrasts based on selected conditions  
  contrasts_filtered <- contrasts %>%
    tidyr::separate(contrast, into = c("cond1", "cond2"), sep = " - ") %>%
    dplyr::filter(cond1 %in% conditions_to_keep & cond2 %in% conditions_to_keep)
  
  brackets_df <- contrasts_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      y.position = dplyr::case_when(
        (cond1 == "SR" & cond2 == "NS") | (cond1 == "SD" & cond2 == "SR") ~ 3.5,
        (cond1 == "SD" & cond2 == "NS") ~ 4,
        TRUE ~ 3
      ),
      annotation = sapply(p.value, get_sig_label),
      cond1 = factor(cond1, levels = c("NS", "SR", "SD")),
      cond2 = factor(cond2, levels = c("NS", "SR", "SD"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(index, cond1, cond2, y.position, annotation)
  
  # Factor setup  
  indices <- c("cpvf", "pvsvf", "mfwi", "alps")
  emm_plot$index <- factor(emm_plot$index, levels = indices)
  emm_plot$condition <- factor(emm_plot$condition, levels = conditions_to_keep)
  lme_plot$index <- factor(lme_plot$index, levels = indices)
  lme_plot$condition <- factor(lme_plot$condition, levels = conditions_to_keep)
  brackets_df$index <- factor(brackets_df$index, levels = indices)
  
  new_labels <- c(
    alps = "DTI-ALPS",
    cpvf = "ChP Volume",
    mfwi = "Free Water Index",
    pvsvf = "PVS Volume"
  )
  
  # Main plot  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Solid violin with black outline
    geom_violin(
      data = lme_plot, 
      aes(x = condition, y = value_plot, fill = condition),
      color = "black", alpha = 1
    ) +
    
    # Black boxplot inside violin
    geom_boxplot(
      data = lme_plot, 
      aes(x = condition, y = value_plot),
      width = 0.05, fill = "black", color = "black"
    ) +
    
    # Mean points and connecting lines
    geom_line(
      data = emm_plot, 
      aes(x = condition, y = emmean_plot, group = 1),
      color = "darkgrey", size = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = emm_plot, 
      aes(x = condition, y = emmean_plot),
      size = 4, shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 1.2
    ) +
    
    # Significance brackets
    ggsignif::geom_signif(
      data = brackets_df,
      aes(xmin = cond1, xmax = cond2, annotations = annotation, y_position = y.position),
      manual = TRUE,
      tip_length = 0.03,
      textsize = 6,
      vjust = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    ylim(-3, 4) +
    facet_wrap(~ index, ncol = 4, scales = "fixed", labeller = labeller(index = new_labels)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = protocolors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = conditions_to_keep) +
    labs(
      x = "Sleep Condition",
      y = "Z-Scored Index",
      title = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

### 8 Site effects

There appears to be a significant contribution of site (as expected). Let's check the distributions.

```{r}
plot_site_violins <- function(lme_df) {
  
   # Refactor
  site_df <- lme_df %>%
    mutate(
      index = factor(
        index,
        levels = c("cpvf", "pvsvf", "mfwi", "alps"),
        labels = c("(A) Choroid Plexus Volume", "(B) Perivascular Space Volume",
                   "(C) Free Water Index", "(D) DTI-ALPS Index")
      )
    )

  # Find sites that differ significantly from every other site (tukey adjusted)
  strict_sig_sites <- function(d) {
    sites <- as.character(unique(d$site))
    if (length(sites) < 2) return(character(0))

    fit <- lm(value_z ~ site, data = d)
    pw  <- as.data.frame(pairs(emmeans(fit, ~ site), adjust = "tukey"))

    sig_sites <- character(0)
    for (s in sites) {
      all_sig <- TRUE
      for (o in setdiff(sites, s)) {
        row <- pw[pw$contrast %in% c(paste(s, "-", o), paste(o, "-", s)), ]
        if (nrow(row) == 0 || row$p.value[1] >= 0.05) {
          all_sig <- FALSE
          break
        }
      }
      if (all_sig) sig_sites <- c(sig_sites, s)
    }
    sig_sites
  }

  # Apply the test within each index
  sig_all <- bind_rows(lapply(split(site_df, site_df$index), function(d) {
    s <- strict_sig_sites(d)
    if (length(s) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(index = unique(d$index), site = s)
  }))

  # Position the stars just above the highest value per site and index
  if (nrow(sig_all) > 0) {
    label_pos <- site_df %>%
      mutate(site = as.character(site)) %>%
      group_by(index, site) %>%
      summarise(y = max(value_z, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.25, .groups = "drop")

    sig_all <- sig_all %>%
      left_join(label_pos, by = c("index", "site")) %>%
      mutate(label = "*")
  }

  # Build the plot
  p <- ggplot(site_df, aes(x = site, y = value_z, fill = site)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, color = NA) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ index, nrow = 2, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = site_colors) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(x = "Site", y = "Normalized Index Value", fill = "Site")

  # Add significance
  if (nrow(sig_all) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = sig_all,
      aes(x = site, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 6
    )
  }

  p
}
```

Plot:

```{r}
plot_site_violins(lme_df)
ggsave(
  filename = f("{output}/site_violin.png"),
  width = 15,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)
```

There appears to be a significant site-based effect for the ALPS and especially the FWI indices. 
We will run a leave-one-site-out bootstrapping analysis to make sure our main findings are not confounded.

```{r}
fit_lme_bootstrap <- function(lme_df) {
  tryCatch({
    model <- nlme::lme(
      value_z ~ condition * index + age + sex_male + time_sec_z,
      random = ~ 1 | participant_id,
      data = lme_df,
      na.action = na.omit,
      control = nlme::lmeControl(
        msMaxIter = 100,
        opt = "optim"
      )
    )
    
    broom.mixed::tidy(model) |>
      dplyr::filter(term %in% c("conditionSD", "conditionSR")) |>
      dplyr::select(term, estimate, p.value) |>
      dplyr::mutate(converged = TRUE)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble::tibble(
      term = c("conditionSD", "conditionSR"),
      estimate = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      converged = FALSE,
      error = e$message
    )
  })
}

loso_results <- function(df, site_var = "site") {
  
  sites <- unique(df[[site_var]])
  
  purrr::map_dfr(sites, function(s) {
    
    df_sub <- df |>
      dplyr::filter(.data[[site_var]] != s) |>
      dplyr::group_by(participant_id) |>
      dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() > 1) |>
      dplyr::ungroup()
    
    fit_lme_bootstrap(df_sub) |>
      dplyr::mutate(left_out_site = s)
  })
}

loso_res <- loso_results(lme_df)

```

Filter for any sites that caused an error in convergence:

```{r}
loso_res |>
  dplyr::filter(converged == FALSE) |>
  dplyr::distinct(left_out_site, error)
```

Give a summary of the outcomes:

```{r}
loso_summary <- loso_res |>
  dplyr::filter(converged == TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(significant = p.value < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::group_by(term) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_models = n(),
    n_sig = sum(significant),
    prop_sig = mean(significant),
    worst_p = max(p.value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

loso_summary

```

### 11 Refit Model Excluding ChPV (POST HOC 2)

ChPV might not change acutely in a similar way that PVSV, FWI, and ALPS do. 
Therefore, we should also fit the same LME and RLME models excluding ChPV from the composite index.

```{r}
lme_nochp <- lme_df |> filter(index != "cpvf")
results_nochp <- fit_lme(lme_nochp)
```

Report:

```{r}
results$report |>
  filter(term != "indexcpvf")
results_nochp$report
```

Differences:
* Most previously significant effects persist and are strengthened
* PVSV main effect became significant
* FWI interaction effect became non-significant
* The effect of time of day went from non-significant to highly significant (where later hours are associated with increased PVS, FWI, and DTI-ALPS index)
* Non-normality of residuals persist, requiring re-assessment with RLME (see below)

Model performance:

### 12. Correlation Matrix

Changes across MRI indices may be correlated with other sleep-related variables, e.g. KSS,chronotype, and PVT.
We will create a correlogram of all continuous variables, and violin plots for all ordinal/categorical variables.

Let's first set our variables/labels:

```{r}
mri_vars   <- c("cpvf", "pvsvf", "mfwi", "alps")
  mri_labels <- c(
    cpvf  = "ChP Volume",
    pvsvf = "PVS Volume",
    mfwi  = "Free Water Index",
    alps  = "DTI-ALPS"
  )
```

Create a function for plotting the correlogram:

```{r}
plot_correlogram <- function(lme_df, mri_vars, mri_labels) {
  
  
  # Prepare violin data
  violin_df <- lme_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(index == "alps" & abs(value_z) > 2)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      value_plot = value_z, # ALPS already reinverted
      index = factor(index, levels = mri_vars),
      index_label = dplyr::recode(
        index,
        cpvf  = "ChP Volume",
        pvsvf = "PVS Volume",
        mfwi  = "Free Water Index",
        alps  = "DTI-ALPS"
      ),
      chronotype = factor(chronotype,
                          levels = c("morning", "intermediate", "evening"),
                          labels = c("Morning", "Intermediate", "Evening")),
      sex_male = factor(sex_male,
                   levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"),
                   labels = c("Female", "Male"))
    )
  
  ylims <- c(-2, 4.5)
  
  # Prepare brackets
  
  prepare_brackets <- function(df, xvar) {
  
    if (xvar == "sex_male") {
      pairwise <- df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(index_label) %>%
        rstatix::t_test(value_plot ~ sex_male) %>%
        rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "sex_male") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          y.position = 3.5
        )
      
    } else {
      pairwise <- df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(index_label) %>%
        rstatix::pairwise_t_test(value_plot ~ chronotype) %>%
        rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "chronotype") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          # convert to character
          group1 = as.character(group1),
          group2 = as.character(group2),
          # assign fixed y-positions
          y.position = dplyr::case_when(
            group1 == "Morning"   & group2 == "Intermediate"  ~ 3.5,
            group1 == "Intermediate" & group2 == "Evening"   ~ 3.5,
            group1 == "Morning"   & group2 == "Evening"      ~ 4,
            TRUE                                               ~ 3.5
          )
        )
      
    }
  
    # Add significance labels
    pairwise <- pairwise %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        annotation = dplyr::case_when(
          p < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p < 0.01  ~ "**",
          p < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE      ~ NA
        ),
        index = factor(index_label, levels = unique(index_label))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(annotation)) |>
      dplyr::ungroup()
  
    return(pairwise)
  }
  
  # Compute brackets
  sex_brackets <- prepare_brackets(violin_df, "sex_male")
  chrono_brackets <- prepare_brackets(violin_df, "chronotype")
  
  
  plot_violin_brackets <- function(df, xvar, col_title, brackets, sex = TRUE) {
  
    # Compute means per xvar
    means <- df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(index_label, .data[[xvar]]) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(mean_val = mean(value_plot, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
    ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = value_plot, fill = index)) +
      geom_violin(color = "black", alpha = 1) +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, fill = "black", color = "black") +
      geom_line(
        data = means,
        aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = mean_val, group = 1),
        color = "darkgrey",
        size = 0.7,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = means,
        aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = mean_val),
        color = "black", fill = "white", shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 1.2
      ) +
      ggsignif::geom_signif(
        data = brackets,
        aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, annotations = annotation, y_position = y.position),
        manual = TRUE,
        tip_length = 0.03,
        textsize = 8,
        vjust = 0.5,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = ylims) +
      facet_wrap(~index_label, ncol = 1, scales = "fixed", strip.position = "right") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = index_colors) +
      labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = ifelse(sex, "Z-scored index", ""),
        title = col_title
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
      theme(
        strip.text.y = if (sex==FALSE) element_text(face = "bold", size = 18) else element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
        title.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 6),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
      )
  }
  
  # Create violin plots
  
  sex_plot <- plot_violin_brackets(
    df = violin_df %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c("index_label","index","value_plot","sex_male"))),
    xvar = "sex_male",
    col_title = "Sex",
    brackets = sex_brackets,
    sex = TRUE
  )
  
  chrono_plot <- plot_violin_brackets(
    df = violin_df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c("index_label", "index", "value_plot", "chronotype"))) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(chronotype)),
    xvar = "chronotype",
    col_title = "Chronotype",
    brackets = chrono_brackets,
    sex = FALSE
  )
  
  violin_panel <- (sex_plot | chrono_plot)
    
  # Create collegram
  
  corr_vars <- c("age", "bmi", "psqi_score", "kss", "pvt_meanrs", "alps", "mfwi", "pvsvf", "cpvf")
  corr_labels <- c("Age", "BMI", "PSQI", "KSS", "PVT RS",
                   "ALPS", "FWI", "PVSV", "ChPV")
  
  corr_df <- melted_data |>
    mutate(
      time_sec = as.numeric(time),
      kss = as.numeric(as.character(kss)), # Coerce to numeric without normalization
      psqi_score = as.numeric(as.character(psqi_score))) # Coerce to numeric, invert
  
  # Select only relevant columns
  corr_data <- corr_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(corr_vars))
  
  # Compute correlation matrix (Spearman) with p-values
  corr_res <- Hmisc::rcorr(as.matrix(corr_data), type = "spearman")
  
  # Extract correlation coefficients and p-values
  corr_mat <- corr_res$r
  p_mat <- corr_res$P
  
  corr_long <- as.data.frame(corr_mat) %>%
    mutate(Var1 = rownames(corr_mat)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Var1, names_to = "Var2", values_to = "Correlation")
  
  p_long <- as.data.frame(p_mat) %>%
    mutate(Var1 = rownames(p_mat)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Var1, names_to = "Var2", values_to = "p_value")
  
  # Merge correlation and p-values
  corr_plot_data <- left_join(corr_long, p_long, by = c("Var1", "Var2"))
  
  # Add significance asterisks
  corr_plot_data <- corr_plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      ),
      label = ifelse(sig != "", paste0(round(Correlation, 2), sig), round(Correlation, 2)),
      bold = ifelse(sig != "", "bold", "plain"),
      alpha_sig = ifelse(sig == "", 0.4, 1)  # non-significant = greyed out
    )
  
  # Map variable names to labels
  label_map <- setNames(corr_labels, corr_vars)
  corr_plot_data <- corr_plot_data %>%
    mutate(Var1 = label_map[Var1],
           Var2 = label_map[Var2])
  
  # Create color vectors for x/y-axis positions
  x_colors <- rep("black", length(corr_labels))
  y_colors <- rep("black", length(corr_labels))
  
  # Assign colors manually based on positions
  pos <- c(2,5,8,4)
  x_colors[pos] <- c("#4292C6", "#AB63C2", "#D73027", "#FC8D59")
  y_colors[pos] <- c("#4292C6", "#AB63C2", "#D73027", "#FC8D59")
  
  # Assign bold for same positions
  x_face <- rep("plain", length(corr_labels))
  y_face <- rep("plain", length(corr_labels))
  x_face[pos] <- "bold"
  y_face[pos] <- "bold"
  
  # Plot with manual colors/faces
  corr_plot <- ggplot(corr_plot_data, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = Correlation)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label, fontface = bold, alpha = alpha_sig), size = 6) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4292C6", mid = "white", high = "#D73027", midpoint = 0,
                         name = "Estimate") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 18,
                                 color = x_colors, face = x_face),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18,
                                 color = y_colors, face = y_face),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
    ) +
    ggtitle("") +
    coord_fixed()
  
  # Combine plots
  
  final_plot <- corr_plot | violin_panel +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(2, 3))
  
  return(final_plot)

}
```

Plot:

```{r}
correlogram <- plot_correlogram(lme_df, mri_vars, mri_labels)
ggsave(
  glue::glue("{output}/correlogram.png"),
  correlogram,
  width = 22, height = 14, dpi = 600
)
```

The NS and SD condition have the cleanest spread of values. We will create a pseudo-time course
where we group data points by 30-minute bins and test if they are different from baseline:

Set some labels:

```{r}
mri_labels_short <- c(
  "cpvf"  = "ChPV",
  "pvsvf" = "PVSV",
  "mfwi"  = "FWI",
  "alps"  = "ALPS"
)

condition_labels <- c(
  "NS" = "Normal Sleep",
  "SD" = "Sleep Deprivation",
  "SR" = "Sleep Restriction"
)
```

Create a function for plotting a binned timecourse:

```{r}
plot_binned_timecourse <- function(condition_name, df) {
  
  # Prepare binned raw data 
  binned_df <- df |>
    filter(condition == condition_name) |>
    mutate(
      time_sec  = as.numeric(time_sec),
      value_z   = ifelse(index == "alps", -value_z, value_z),
      time_bin  = floor(time_sec / 1800) * 1800,
      bin_start = time_bin,
      bin_end   = time_bin + 1800,
      index     = factor(index, levels = c("cpvf", "pvsvf", "mfwi", "alps"))
    )
  
  # Bin means for plotting
  bin_means <- binned_df |>
    group_by(index, bin_start, bin_end) |>
    summarise(
      mean_z = mean(value_z, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Bin-wise tests vs baseline (0)
  bin_tests <- binned_df |>
    group_by(index, bin_start, bin_end) |>
    summarise(
      n      = sum(!is.na(value_z)),
      mean_z = mean(value_z, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_val  = ifelse(
        n >= 2,
        t.test(value_z, mu = 0)$p.value,
        NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(p_val), p_val < 0.05) |>
    mutate(
      x_star = (bin_start + bin_end) / 2,
      y_star = mean_z + ifelse(mean_z >= 0, 0.12, -0.32)
    )
  
  # Plot
  ggplot(bin_means) +
    
    # Filled bins
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = bin_start,
        xmax = bin_end,
        ymin = pmin(mean_z, 0),
        ymax = pmax(mean_z, 0),
        fill = index
      ),
      alpha = 0.25,
      color = NA
    ) +
    
    # Stepwise mean line
    geom_step(
      aes(x = bin_start, y = mean_z, color = index, group = index),
      linewidth = 1.4,
      direction = "hv"
    ) +
    
    # Significance markers
    geom_text(
      data = bin_tests,
      aes(x = x_star, y = y_star, label = "*", color = index),
      size = 10,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    # Baseline
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
    
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = index_colors,
      breaks = mri_vars,
      labels = mri_labels_short
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = index_colors,
      breaks = mri_vars,
      labels = mri_labels_short
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(6 * 3600, 22 * 3600),
      labels = function(x)
        format(as.POSIXct(x, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"), "%H:%M"),
      breaks = seq(0, 24 * 3600, by = 2 * 3600)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2)) +
    
    labs(
      x = "Time of Day",
      y = "Mean Z-Normalized Index",
      fill = "Index",
      color = "Index",
      title = condition_labels[condition_name]
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}
```

The distribution of acquisition times is similar between NS and SD. Let's compare these two conditions.

```{r}
# Generate NS and SD plots

plot_NS <- plot_binned_timecourse("NS", lme_df)
```

### 12. Acute vs. Chronic SR 

Although acute SR (1 night) and chronic SR (3-5 nights) were grouped in the main analyses (to allow for balanced group comparisons)
We should see if separating them yields any different results.

Due to insufficient contrasts, we can only look at ChPV and PVSV:

```{r}
fit_rlme_sr <- function(sr_df) {
  # Ensure condition factor levels 
  sr_df <- sr_df |>
    dplyr::filter(index %in% c("cpvf", "pvsvf")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      condition = factor(condition, levels = c("NS", "aSR", "cSR"))
    )
  
  # Fit robust linear mixed-effects model 
  model_robust <- robustlmm::rlmer(
    value_z ~ condition * index + age + sex_male + time_sec +
      (1 | participant_id) + (1 | site),
    data = sr_df
  )
  
  # Model summary
  print(summary(model_robust))
  
  # Tidy output
  report <- broom.mixed::tidy(model_robust)
  print(report)
  
  # Assumption checks 
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  # 4-panel layout
  
  # Residuals vs Fitted
  plot(fitted(model_robust), resid(model_robust),
       xlab = "Fitted values", ylab = "Residuals",
       main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
  abline(h = 0, col = "red")
  
  # Q-Q plot of residuals
  qqnorm(resid(model_robust), main = "Q-Q plot of residuals")
  qqline(resid(model_robust))
  
  # Q-Q plot of random effects (intercepts)
  ranef_df <- ranef(model_robust)[[1]]
  ranef_vals <- ranef_df[, 1]
  qqnorm(ranef_vals, main = "Q-Q plot of random effects (intercepts)")
  qqline(ranef_vals)
  
  # ACF of residuals
  acf(resid(model_robust), main = "ACF of residuals")
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))  # reset layout
  
  # Shapiro-Wilk test
  cat("\nShapiro-Wilk normality test on residuals:\n")
  print(shapiro.test(resid(model_robust)))
  
  # Effects plot
  tryCatch({
    eff_obj <- effects::allEffects(model_robust)
    plot(eff_obj)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("⚠️ Could not plot allEffects(): ", e$message)
  })
  
  # Estimated marginal means and contrasts 
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(model_robust, ~ condition | index)
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)
  
  # Generate pairwise contrasts for all condition combinations
  contrasts <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", adjust = "fdr") |>
    as.data.frame()
  
  print(contrasts)
  
  # Assess model performance
  performance <- model_performance(model_robust)
  
  # Return results 
  return(list(
    model = model_robust,
    report = report,
    performance = performance,
    emm = emm_df,
    contrasts = contrasts
  ))
}

```

Fit RLME:

```{r}
results_sr <- fit_rlme_sr(sr_df)
```

Show results:

```{r}
results_sr$contrasts
```

Calculate effect sizes:

```{r}
contrasts_sr <- as.data.frame(results_sr$contrasts)
contrasts_sr$d <- contrasts_sr$estimate / sigma(results_sr$model)
contrasts_sr
```

Adapt the plotting function to work with these data:

```{r}
plot_rlme3 <- function(lme_df, emm_df, contrasts) {
  
  conditions_to_keep <- c("NS", "aSR", "cSR")
  indices_to_keep <- c("cpvf", "pvsvf")
  
  # Filter data frames 
  lme_plot <- lme_df |>
    dplyr::filter(
      condition %in% conditions_to_keep,
      index %in% indices_to_keep
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(value_plot = value_z)
  
  emm_plot <- emm_df |>
    dplyr::filter(
      condition %in% conditions_to_keep,
      index %in% indices_to_keep
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      emmean_plot = emmean,
      asymp.LCL_plot = asymp.LCL,
      asymp.UCL_plot = asymp.UCL
    )
  
  # significance labels 
  get_sig_label <- function(p) {
    if (p < 0.001) "***"
    else if (p < 0.01) "**"
    else if (p < 0.05) "*"
    else "ns"
  }
  
  # Prepare contrasts 
  contrasts_filtered <- contrasts |>
    tidyr::separate(contrast, into = c("cond1", "cond2"), sep = " - ") |>
    dplyr::filter(
      cond1 %in% conditions_to_keep,
      cond2 %in% conditions_to_keep,
      index %in% indices_to_keep
    )
  
  # Dynamic y positions per facet 
  y_max <- lme_plot |>
    dplyr::group_by(index) |>
    dplyr::summarise(y = max(value_plot, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  brackets_df <- contrasts_filtered |>
    dplyr::left_join(y_max, by = "index") |>
    dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      cond1 = factor(cond1, levels = conditions_to_keep),
      cond2 = factor(cond2, levels = conditions_to_keep),
      annotation = sapply(p.value, get_sig_label),
      
      pair_type = dplyr::case_when(
        abs(as.numeric(cond1) - as.numeric(cond2)) == 1 ~ 1,
        abs(as.numeric(cond1) - as.numeric(cond2)) == 2 ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ 3
      ),
      
      y.position = y + 0.5 * pair_type
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(index, cond1, cond2, y.position, annotation)
  
  # Factor setup 
  lme_plot$index <- factor(lme_plot$index, levels = indices_to_keep)
  emm_plot$index <- factor(emm_plot$index, levels = indices_to_keep)
  brackets_df$index <- factor(brackets_df$index, levels = indices_to_keep)
  
  lme_plot$condition <- factor(lme_plot$condition, levels = conditions_to_keep)
  emm_plot$condition <- factor(emm_plot$condition, levels = conditions_to_keep)
  
  new_labels <- c(
    cpvf = "ChP Volume",
    pvsvf = "PVS Volume"
  )
  
  # plot 
  p <- ggplot() +
    
    geom_violin(
      data = lme_plot,
      aes(x = condition, y = value_plot, fill = condition),
      color = "black", alpha = 1
    ) +
    
    geom_boxplot(
      data = lme_plot,
      aes(x = condition, y = value_plot),
      width = 0.05,
      fill = "black",
      color = "black",
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    
    geom_line(
      data = emm_plot,
      aes(x = condition, y = emmean_plot, group = 1),
      color = "darkgrey",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    
    geom_point(
      data = emm_plot,
      aes(x = condition, y = emmean_plot),
      size = 4,
      shape = 21,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      stroke = 1.2
    ) +
    
    ggsignif::geom_signif(
      data = brackets_df,
      aes(
        xmin = cond1,
        xmax = cond2,
        annotations = annotation,
        y_position = y.position
      ),
      manual = TRUE,
      tip_length = 0.03,
      textsize = 5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    facet_wrap(~ index, ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(index = new_labels)) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = protocolors) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = conditions_to_keep) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.2))) +
    
    labs(
      x = "Sleep Condition",
      y = "Z-Scored Index",
      title = ""
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(p)
}

```

```{r}
)
```

### 13. Brain Parenchymal Index (POST HOC 3)

To what extent can age-related alterations be explained by changes in brain morphology?
This section plots age alongside the brain parenchymal fraction (GM + WM / ICV)

Run BPF model:

```{r}
bpf_lme <- nlme::lme(
    value_z ~ condition * index + age * bpf + sex_male + time_sec_z,
    random = ~ 1 | participant_id,
    data = lme_df
  )
```

BPF Estimated Marginal Means:

```{r}
  as.data.frame()
bpf_emm <- bpf_emm |> as.data.frame()
bpf_contrasts
```

Create a function for BPF plotting using means and contrasts:

```{r}
plot_bpf <- function(df, contrasts_df) {
  
  condition_levels <- c("NS", "aSR", "cSR", "SD")
  
  # Clean raw data 
  df_plot <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(bpf), !is.na(condition)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      condition = factor(condition, levels = condition_levels),
      bpf = as.numeric(as.character(bpf))
    )
  
  # Means
  mean_df <- df_plot %>%
    dplyr::group_by(condition) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_bpf = mean(bpf, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sd(bpf, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = condition_levels))
  
  # Significance labels 
  get_sig_label <- function(p) {
    if (p < 0.001) "***"
    else if (p < 0.01) "**"
    else if (p < 0.05) "*"
    else "ns"
  }
  
  # Brackets 
  brackets_df <- contrasts_df %>%
    tidyr::separate(contrast, into = c("cond1", "cond2"), sep = " - ") %>%
    dplyr::filter(cond1 %in% condition_levels & cond2 %in% condition_levels) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cond1 = factor(cond1, levels = condition_levels),
      cond2 = factor(cond2, levels = condition_levels),
      annotation = sapply(p.value, get_sig_label),
      
      pair_type = dplyr::case_when(
        abs(as.numeric(cond1) - as.numeric(cond2)) == 1 ~ 1,
        abs(as.numeric(cond1) - as.numeric(cond2)) == 2 ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ 3
      ),
      
      y.position = max(df_plot$bpf, na.rm = TRUE) +
        0.05 * pair_type
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05)
  
  # Plot 
  p <- ggplot(df_plot) +
    
    geom_violin(
      aes(x = condition, y = bpf, fill = condition),
      color = "black",
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(x = condition, y = bpf),
      width = 0.05,
      fill = "black",
      color = "black",
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    
    # Mean line
    geom_line(
      data = mean_df,
      aes(x = condition, y = mean_bpf, group = 1),
      linewidth = 1,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    
    # Mean points
    geom_point(
      data = mean_df,
      aes(x = condition, y = mean_bpf),
      size = 4,
      shape = 21,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      stroke = 1.2
    ) +
    
    # Brackets
    ggsignif::geom_signif(
      data = brackets_df,
      aes(
        xmin = cond1,
        xmax = cond2,
        annotations = annotation,
        y_position = y.position
      ),
      manual = TRUE,
      tip_length = 0.03,
      textsize = 5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = protocolors) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = condition_levels) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15))) +
    
    labs(
      x = "Sleep Condition",
      y = "BPF",
      title = ""
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
)
```

We want to see whether age-related changes are also associated with morphological alterations.
In this case, we should those changes alongside changes in the bpf and see if trajectories line up:

```{r}
plot_age_trends <- function(lme_df) {
  
  df <- lme_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      bpf_z = as.numeric(scale(bpf))
    )
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = age)) +
    
    # BPF scatter
    geom_point(
      aes(y = bpf_z),
      color = "#1b9e77",
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 2
    ) +
    
    # BPF smooth
    geom_smooth(
      aes(y = bpf_z),
      color = "black",
      se = TRUE,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    
    # Index scatter
    geom_point(
      aes(y = value_z, color = index),
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 2
    ) +
    
    # Index smooth
    geom_smooth(
      aes(y = value_z),
      color = "black",
      se = TRUE,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = index_colors) +
    
    labs(
      x = "Age",
      y = "Standardized value",
      color = "Index"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```
